Shujinkou Digital Artbook - [url="https://ricegames.net/shujinkou/digital-artbook/"]Learn More[/url][/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Application - Shujinkou Select Soundtrack - [url="https://ricegames.net/shujinkou/select-soundtrack/"]Learn More[/url][/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🏜️ Introducing the Sabaku Arc[/h3][p]The major price change for the standard edition is a result of Shujinkou being split into two parts, as the game features two full-length story arcs (40+ hours each)—specifically, the [b]Genya Arc[/b] and the [b]Sabaku Arc[/b].[/p][p]The PS and PC versions come with both arcs included (effectively two games in one), but the [b]Sabaku Arc[/b] will be sold separately on the Nintendo Switch. [/p][p]The [b]Sabaku Arc[/b] takes place immediately after the end of the [b]Genya Arc[/b], and will be available separately for the following prices:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="256,,,,"][tr][th colwidth="256"][p]Product Name[/p][/th][th][p]USD[/p][/th][th][p]CAD[/p][/th][th][p]EUR[/p][/th][th][p]GBP[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="256"][p][i][b]Shujinkou - Sabaku Arc[/b][/i][/p][/td][td][p]$24.99[/p][/td][td][p]$33.99[/p][/td][td][p]€24.99[/p][/td][td][p]£19.99[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][i][b]With this news, brand new Key Art for the Sabaku Arc makes its debut below:[/b][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/48896c2ab4fe6f4da3606cfff0405a7850b77672.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]📜 More About Shujinkou[/h3][p]Shujinkou marks Rice Games' debut commercial title and the [b]first installment in a planned trilogy[/b]. The game's expansive world spans six nations, each with its own story arc and a rich cast of major and minor characters.

This year's release includes both the [b]Genya Arc[/b] and the [b]Sabaku Arc[/b]. The [b]Genya Arc[/b] follows the battle against the language-devouring "Akuma" to save Shu’s homeland, while the [b]Sabaku Arc[/b] explores diplomacy in a new nation and the struggle to alter an ally's prophesied fate, revealed through a mysterious painting.

Each arc offers roughly 40–60 hours of gameplay and introduces its own cast of new protagonists to befriend and antagonists to face.[/p][p][/p][h3]💯 Thousands of Players Learning [i]AND[/i] Gaming! [/h3][p]Since launch, thousands of players around the world have enjoyed Shujinkou, with many fans sharing directly with us that the game inspired them to [u][b]start pursuing Japanese language classes[/b][/u] and even [u][b]helped some land new jobs[/b][/u] connected to their passion for Japanese.

Others have spent hundreds of hours exploring Shujinkou's 200 quests, multiple minigames, and thousands of character interactions across its expansive cast. Based on player data, earning the Platinum trophy typically takes roughly 250 hours, reflecting Shujinkou's breadth of unique content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/55fdce05ecbdd4ac41b10c96c2924dee6f0508d8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]⚙️ Reviews and Feedback[/h3][p]Preliminary reviews have been excellent, with Shujinkou earning a [b]90[/b] [url="https://www.metacritic.com/game/shujinkou/"]Metacritic[/url] score ([i]Universal Acclaim[/i]) and a [b]94[/b] [url="https://opencritic.com/game/18105/shujinkou"]OpenCritic[/url] Top Critic score as of August 2025. [/p][p][/p][p]We've submitted over 70 review keys worldwide, but as a small self-publishing studio, it remains a challenge to gain broad media attention. Sales have been modest on PC but have exceeded expectations on PlayStation, and we remain committed to supporting the game with [i]monthly patches[/i] across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Looking forward with the Nintendo Switch port[/h3][p]With its upcoming Nintendo Switch release, players can explore dozens of handcrafted labyrinths on the go and even use the [b]touchscreen[/b] to practice writing hiragana, katakana, and a wide range of kanji.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/b2f4dfdfdc36de163097c06955706abf691d6d0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🍚 About the Rice Games Team[/h3][p]Rice Games Inc is a multilingual team of game developers from around the world. Many team members are fluent or native speakers of multiple languages, including English, Japanese, German, and Mandarin.[/p][p]With [url="https://ricegames.net/team/"]teammates[/url] spread across more than seven time zones, ensuring smooth coordination over Shujinkou's [url="https://ricegames.net/about/"][i]over six-year development period[/i][/url] was no small feat. The team's global presence spans several countries, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]United States[/b]: California, Hawaii, Washington, Texas, Florida, Minnesota, Michigan, Colorado, Utah, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Japan, Australia, United Kingdom, Germany[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rice Games team is composed largely of young, highly motivated individuals eager to leave their mark on the video game industry with their first major commercial release. While some team members bring years of experience—particularly within the Music Team, with arrangement and composition credits—they, too, are venturing into new territory, having never worked on an RPG of Shujinkou's scale.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/920e106efe46196f15a2885801f5d374a5499faa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
Thanks for reading this major update, and we hope to see you dungeon-crawling on the Nintendo Switch next month :).

Team @ Rice Games[/p]

notes.content: [h1]🎉 Shujinkou x Steam Summer Sale! ☀️[/h1][p]From June 26th to July 10th, Shujinkou is 17% off ([b]$49.99[/b]) with its other editions discounted similarly![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fXDA1wqPBt0"][/dynamiclink]Since launch, Shujinkou has received over 100 quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and updates inspired by both player and critic feedback. Key enhancements include Quick Travel within towns, four-way display options via R3, and refined quest and inventory systems. [/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 Feedback from Players & Critics Addressed![/h3][p]Most recently, we have released Patch v1.39 and v1.40, which both add a whole slew of brand new features and optimizations to improve the player experience. Tech-Gaming also interviewed the director of Shujinkou, talking about the development process, its immersive 158-track soundtrack, growing the Shujinkou franchise, and a look into the future for this trilogy saga.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1386630/view/500576552635859534?l=english"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1386630/view/498324120760483940?l=english"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1386630/view/824835185591719969?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]🌟 GameGrin Review (8.5/10)[/h3][p]Furthermore, GameGrin recently released their review of Shujinkou, giving it an 8.5/10[/p][p][b]🔗 Review Link[/b]: [url="https://www.gamegrin.com/reviews/shujinkou-review/"]https://www.gamegrin.com/reviews/shujinkou-review/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]"Other than a few niggles with the controls, I really found Shujinkou to be a pleasure to play. I didn’t feel like I was studying, and often, great educational tools do just that. Do I think I could go have a conversation in Japanese yet? No, absolutely not, and I think I will need more than just this game to learn. I do, however, feel much more confident with the language than I did before I started playing, and I will keep playing. Above all, this is a great little love-letter to classic JRPGs first and foremost, with the learning being the cherry on top of a lovely little videogame cake.[/i]" - Gary Sheppard[/p][p][/p][p]With this, Shujinkou currently sits at an [b][u]89 on Metacritic[/u][/b] and a [b][u]94 on OpenCritic[/u][/b]. [/p][p][b]🔗 Metacritic[/b]: [url="https://www.metacritic.com/game/shujinkou/"]https://www.metacritic.com/game/shujinkou/[/url][/p][p][b]🔗 OpenCritic[/b]: [url="https://opencritic.com/game/18105/shujinkou"]https://opencritic.com/game/18105/shujinkou[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/b74cf141f6a578ec51d6820aa4c3181b780adde9.png"][/img][/p][h3]🗣️ Check Our Discord Community![/h3][p]Feel free to join our Discord community if you would like to directly communicate with the Rice Games team and current fans and players of Shujinkou![/p][p][b]🔗 Discord Invitation[/b]: [url="https://discord.com/invite/UdCdvSuwpk"]https://discord.com/invite/UdCdvSuwpk[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading this and we hope you have a great summer playing all of the amazing games here on Steam 😀![/p][p]Team @ Rice Games[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.38
notes.content:
[h1]Shujinkou v1.38[/h1]
[h2]Polish / Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] It's finally here! [b]Demo to Full Game Save Data Transfer for PS5[/b] is out now. You can access this by going to the Options Screen by the Main Menu. If you already have save data that exists in the full game, please note that [b]it will be deleted if you initiate a Demo Transfer[/b]. This function is applied to ALL three save slots at once. For those who have waited to transfer their data to the full game, thank you for your patience!
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with certain Kanji orbs not appearing in the Kanakae Equip menu if the player has collected over 100 Kanji orbs.
[*] Fixed typos and issues in: [b]Momoko's Super Important Mission[/b], [b]New Threads[/b], [b]She Wore Asagao[/b], [b]Herb Remedy[/b], [b]No Such Thing as Ghosts[/b], [b]Something Tasty[/b], and [b]Where's My Sister?[/b].
[*] Added missing helper dialogue for a couple of Youkyuu (quests).
[*] Fixed issue with a selectable choice in dialogue not working properly in Tsunako's second Kizuna quest.
[*] Added better error handling regarding edge cases with Kanakae in Battle.
[*] Fix rare issue with being unable to harvest the [b]Ichijiku[/b] (Fig) from a resource spot in Meiro 1.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] More optimizations make the game load [b]0.1s faster[/b] than before on weaker devices.
[/list]
[h2]Our Biggest Priorities[/h2]
[list]
[*] We want to add a "Fast-Forward" (by holding a certain key) to some minigames so that they can be played and progressed through more quickly.
[*] D-pad issues for movement
[/list]

We will be taking a short break on polish and fixes for Shujinkou for the next few weeks and [b]focus on other console ports[/b] as well as [b]planning the architecture[/b] for future Shujinkou-related projects.

[b]Thank you all for your support so far[/b]. Spanning all platforms, it's amazing to already see thousands of players around the world enjoying Shujinkou, and we're just getting started!

If you ever encounter an issue or want to get in contact with us, please [b]find us at our Discord server[/b] or [b]send us an email[/b]!
Julian Rice

notes.title: Patch - Steam Cloud Fix
notes.content:
[h1]Shujinkou Hot Patch - Steam Cloud Fix[/h1]
This small update (linked build # included) fixes the Steam Cloud saving / loading issue that was reported by a lot of players. This new patch confirms working Steam Cloud and also includes the new menu called [b]Steam Cloud Save Conflict Menu[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/73a4d7b392b0ad2a5880f32de756da1d4155a7de.jpg[/img]

In this menu, you will have the option to play with [b]locally stored save data[/b] or the last saved [b]Steam Cloud save data[/b].

As mentioned in the help text in the screenshot, please be warned that choosing one save data, then saving the game after that, will cause the other save data to be overwritten and permanently deleted. This also occurs [b]when opening and closing the Option Menu in both the Main Menu and in the Party Menu[/b].

Here is a zoomed-in image for those curious about the flow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/e6078fe325902281f6077e05a432e35700ba311d.jpg[/img]

In the unfortunate event that you unintentionally overwrite the wrong save, please send an email with your [b]Steam username[/b] to [b]contact@ricegames.net[/b] with the subject title [b]Recover Lost Save Data[/b] and we will see if there's anything that can be done to recover it.

If this doesn't appear for you when you start the game, please save the game (with Steam Cloud synced/enabled) [b]once[/b] on the device with your preferred / primary save data, then start the game on your secondary device.

[b]Also, please note that if you pick the Steam Cloud save but do not save when quitting the game, this menu will appear when you return to the Main Menu[/b].

Happy dungeon-crawling! We're finally starting to see some players on PS5 and PC reach the second half of the campaign and approach the conclusion of the story. Our most dedicated players have averaged over 10 hours a day with 150+ hours put into both the game's main and side content! 🤩

Julian

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.33
notes.content:
[h1]Shujinkou v1.33[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix rare crash when interacting with the Lottery system (Takarakuji). Few users affected.
[*] Fix UI crash when receiving a rare drop from an akuma after a successful negotiation. Has a low crash rate of less than 0.5%, but it has happened to more than one player. Sorry!
[*] Fix potential crash when spamming "Back" within 0.5s of confirming a Gamble (difficulty, bet amount, rank select) for a minigame at any Fuu Lobby.
[*] Fix uncommon game crash when a DLC costume is set, then a Genya costume is set back to a certain partner, then a player completes that partner's minigame. Few users affected.
[*] Fix bizarre crash and soft-lock that causes the player to get stuck on a non-interactable NPC in Town 8.
[*] Fixed dialogue for the fishbowl in Tsunako's house playing when interacting with her kimono. Some users affected.
[*] Fix game stall when a group-wide attack move is used on an akuma that is protecting an akuma that has escaped the battle that turn. Some users affected.
[*] Fix game stall when an akuma tries to heal or revive an akuma that has escaped the battle. A fair number of users were affected.
[*] Added missing helper dialogue for Youkyuu: [b]Money Heist[/b], [b]This Hitsuji Has Horns[/b], [b]To Be the Best of Them All[/b], [b]Royal Party[/b], [b]Who Said Pretty Girls Weren't Smart?[/b].
[*] Fixed missing end-dialogue when winning Kotoba Kyuugi at Difficulty 10.
[*] Item Compendium is not synced properly with R3 status (remove the feature)
[*] Fix the dialogue log feature being desynced for: [b]A Brotherly Escapade[/b]
[*] Fix one typo for the Furigana spelling of the youkyuu: [b]A Terrifying Nightmare[/b]
[*] Fix various reported typos by players and our QA team.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/8c29ef98015ba0addd64a31189530e4d3f833a9b.png[/img]
[h2]Polish / Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Change Time in Town[/b]. This interactable event now also supports changing the time to [b]Dusk[/b] and [b]Dawn[/b]. This should make it smoother to progress through some of the youkyuu that have time-of-day limitations.
[*] Skills that replenish TR, MR, or both after a hero's turn or after the end of battle do not trigger if the hero is fully healed for the target stat(s). This slightly improves the flow of battle.
[*] When winning a battle, any skills that heal the heroes after the battle will now properly update the bars of health seen for the hero UI when the battle message appears. This was a minor oversight.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bonus Skills like [b]To Recuperate[/b], [b]To Restore[/b], [b]To Revitalize[/b], [b]To Regenerate[/b], and [b]To Replenish[/b] would not stack, and high-value skills would be overridden by lower-value skills. Now, these skills stack, allowing for more fair usage of AP and strategy.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed Day-only time requirement for interaction with Kobayashi in the Youkyuu: [b]Bouquet Play[/b].
[*] Adjusted wording for more accurate instructions in the Youkyuu: [b]Honoring My Father's Memory[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Our Biggest Feature / Fix Priorities[/h2]
[list]
[*] PS5 Save Data Transfer from Demo to Full Game (optional for those who want to use it).
[*] We are still working on optimizing the PS4 version.
[*] There seems to be an issue with Steam Cloud for many users.
[*] We are working on a fix for playing on ultrawide monitors.
[*] Investigating the Tsuri (Fishing) minigame input issue on some PCs.
[*] Loading Lore Menu in the Party Menu (Lexicon) is in development.
[*] Adding a "Fast-Forward" key to some minigames so that they can be played and progressed through more quickly.
[*] Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night, but also sometimes on the Nation Map.
[*] D-pad movement is not implemented smoothly, The L-stick is a perfectly fine input style (and the intended one) that you can work with while the D-pad implementation is being worked on.
[*] This seems to be an existing issue, but under certain circumstances, the Town music will remain unchanged even when the time of day is changed. This is known and will be patched in v1.34.
[/list]

This is a smaller patch that fixes all of the crash reports and missing dialogue reports we received from PS5, PC, and PS4 users. We know a number of you had to restart the game after encountering these issues, and are very sorry for the inconvenience. Crashes are never intentional, and we do our best to catch everything we can.

Whenever a crash or exception happens, the team gets a notification about it, and I add it to the urgent list of things to fix for the next patch. We'll keep our eyes peeled for any more issues and hope you continue to have a fun time playing through Shujinkou!
Julian Rice

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.32
notes.content:
[h1]Shujinkou v1.32[/h1]
[h2]Polish / Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]PC-Only - Right Click to Go Back[/b]: Now, you can right-click to go back on all menus, including every menu in the Party Menu, Shop menus, Battle menus, and more.
[*] [b]Rank Requirements[/b] for each minigame now displayed in the Records menu when signing up for a minigame. This transparency will allow players to make better decisions as to what rank to gamble for.
[*] New [b]Hold to Mash UI[/b] appears in Tsuri (Fishing) and the Escaping Combat (Nigeru) if enabled, reminding the player what their active setting is.
[*] You can now sell and store [b]Ingredients[/b] at Kurozushi after reaching [b]Town 2[/b].
[*] You can now use [b]R3 / CTRL to cycle between all four displays[/b] (English, Japanese, Furigana, Romaji). This has resulted in various keybind remapping.
[*] [b]R3 / CTRL Keybind Change[/b]: Z / Square / X (Xbox) to change active hero in Kanakae Equip.
[*] [b]R3 / CTRL Keybind Change[/b]: Z / Square / X (Xbox) to change View Category in Kanban Menu.
[*] [b]R3 / CTRL Keybind Change[/b]: Z / Square / X (Xbox) to swap between Armor and Weapons in Daisuke's Mokubukiya.
[*] [b]R3 / CTRL Keybind Change[/b]: Tab / Triangle / Y (Xbox) to change to List View in the Arawasu Skill Tree menu.
[*] [b]R3 / CTRL Keybind Change[/b]: The Battle Sequence Log keybind remains as R3 / CTRL, and the 4-display cycle system will only trigger when looking at a Battle menu that has different text to display, such as the [b]Items[/b] submenu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/e824a19e337016f2e5a6ce4892f8fd581780e60f.png[/img]
[i]Now, you will be able to cycle through four displays and override your current settings at any time, similar to the English-Only mode[/i]. This was a highly requested feature by our language learners.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized PS4 version to reduce likelihood of memory crashes.
[*] Fixed one mistyped choice option in Tatiana's second Kizuna quest.
[*] Fixed spoilers appearing in Ishi 9 for Otogawa and Sugi.
[*] Fixed wrong character named for unlocked costume when completing a series of Kizuna quests.
[*] Fix rare crash during specific conditions when in the Fuu Underground.
[*] Fix potential input issues during specific conditions during Tsuri (Fishing).
[*] Fix issue with save not working over multiple sessions for Jin's Nen'oshi.
[*] Fix inaccurate location details for a certain Chop resource in Labyrinth 6.
[*] Fix issue with sometimes being able to use Kakusei before it fully unlocks.
[*] Added missing dialogue when clearing [b]Sakana Sensou[/b] with [b]Jin[/b] at [b]Difficulty 2[/b].
[*] Fix issue with being able to clear the Quiz without getting everything correct in the quest: [b]Hotel Heartbreak[/b].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/54d2c1fc2afe3e1a458798eb07b94ba08cf540e7.jpg[/img]
[i]Transparency for Rank Requirements[/i]: Note that special terminology (in this case, "Top Score") is defined at the bottom of the list of potential ranks.

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Raised Inventory maximum for Ingredients from [b]60[/b] to [b]99[/b].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/70d2c395633d30c557b39dc8003066f752678de0.png[/img]
[i]If you have Hold to Mash enabled, certain mashing activities will show a new UI component to remind you of the setting. Because input processing currently differs between holding to mash and not holding at all, this should reduce confusion for players having trouble mashing when Hold to Mash is enabled[/i].

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjust grammar and word Kanban so that the sentences on the top take the whole width.
[*] Youkyuu tutorial updated to say a max of "twelve" quests instead of "five."
[/list]

[h2]Our Biggest Feature / Fix Priorities[/h2]
[list]
[*] PS5 Save Data Transfer from Demo to Full Game (optional for those who want to use it).
[*] There seems to be an issue with Steam Cloud for many users.
[*] We are still working on further optimizing the PS4 version.
[*] We are still working on fixing the displays for ultrawide monitors.
[*] Investigating the Tsuri (Fishing) minigame input issue on some PCs.
[*] [b]Loading Lore[/b] Menu in the Party Menu (Lexicon) is in development.
[*] D-pad movement, especially with controller, as well as keyboard-only movement, can be slow and laggy, and not fun for dungeon-crawlers who are more accustomed to D-pad movement (instead of the L-stick, which currently is the smoothest working solution).
[*] We want to add a "Fast-Forward" (by holding a certain key) to some minigames so that they can be played and progressed through more quickly.
[*] BUG: Using [b]To Protect[/b] on an enemy that uses a group-wide attack can cause stalling issues in-game.
[*] BUG: An enemy that attempts to heal an enemy that decides to escape that exact turn can cause stalling issues in-game.
[*] BUG: Some players are running into an input error causing harmless errors on Steam Deck, but the error seems to be Unity package-related instead of being Shujinkou-related.
[*] BUG: At least one player ran into an issue when starting a random encounter. It seems very rare and isolated, and we're looking into the issue.
[*] BUG: Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night (sometimes Dawn), but also sometimes on the Nation Map.
[*] Note: We are aware that there's a syncing input issue in the Item Compendium if the player spams R3 too quickly and will address this for v1.33.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/6662fe0becec4019864b78816a86b349c59410e7.jpg[/img]
[i]Lengthy sentences like the one seen in the Kanban above now take up the entire width of the Kanban page, allowing for greatly reduced likelihood of text overflow into the second line[/i].

As always, thank you for playing! Our team will be getting into marketing mode once a couple more important issues have been ironed out. Expect announcements for cool things in the coming weeks!
Julian Rice

notes.content:

[*] Fixed many player-reported typos with Blue Texts and in-game dialogue.

[*] Fixed a quiet exception (error) related to stroke animation of words and kanji when when interacting with Kanban in the second half of the game.
[*] Fixed a few typos for the romaji and furigana equivalents for some keys (the items).
[*] Added missing explanations for a few copula and particles in [b]Okkake no Osakenori[/b].
[*] Fix a couple typos found relating to the Fuu Lobby and Minigame system.
[*] Added better error handling for a bizarre crash with dialogue that has a 1-3% chance of occurring specifically when Sanrin is unlocked in the Nation Map. So strange...
[*] Refine the position of the Youkyuu ! icon and some speech bubbles for many of the NPCs in Town 6.
[/list]
[h2]Polish / Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented new [b]Update System[/b] for keeping players updated in-game when new updates such as "Patch Notes" are released.
[*] [b]New Option[/b]: Default to Keyboard Icons (off by default)
[*] [b]New Option[/b]: Select between 3 Glyph Sets on Steam Deck and PC
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] To Heal Health - Bumped Cost from [b]30 TR[/b] to [b]75 TR[/b].
[*] To Heal Mana - Bumped Cost from [b]25 MR[/b] to [b]40 MR[/b].
[*] To Gradually Heal - Bumped Cost from [b]40 MR[/b] to [b]60 MR[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Our Biggest Feature / Fix Priorities[/h2]
[list]
[*] PS5 Save Data Transfer from Demo to Full Game (optional for those who want to use it).
[*] We've noticed the PS4 version crashing more often than we'd like—This is due to the device's memory issues, and we are investigating a fix as soon as we can.
[*] We plan on bumping the maximum quests from 5 to 10, 12, or 15 soon.
[*] Some of the grammar and word-based Kanban have long-enough sentences that it makes it hard to read on a smaller screen. We will be adjusting the UI for this.
[*] We are currently working on a proper fix to increase Inventory and Storage capacities for Material and Resource items.
[*] We are working to ensure that L3 / 1 can be used in any menu.
[*] We are working so that existing R3 / CTRL keybinds are changed and the R3 / CTRL keybind allows for display-changing across all four display types in any menu (like the Item Compendium menu).
[*] We've heard reports that the Tsuri (Fishing) minigame may not work properly, or the inputs are not clear enough, for certain PC players. We are investigating this.
[*] We got a request to add a new menu to the Party Menu that allows for players to revisit some of the lengthier lore displayed in the Loading Screens. We're considering implementing this.
[*] Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night (sometimes Dawn), but also sometimes on the Nation Map.
[*] D-pad movement, especially with controller, as well as keyboard-only movement, can be slow and laggy, and not fun for dungeon-crawlers who are more accustomed to D-pad movement (instead of the L-stick, which currently is the smoothest working solution).
[/list]
Thank you so much for playing Shujinkou.

We will be focusing on refining the experience based on player feedback so that Shujinkou can become as refined of a JRPG as it can be.

Don't forget that you can join our Discord Community (with over 500 members!), where fans are able to quickly ask questions, get help, and get directly in touch with the team at Rice Games. Link: https://discord.gg/UdCdvSuwpk


Thanks again, and we'll see you in your next crawling session!
Julian Rice

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.29
notes.content:
[h1]Shujinkou v1.29[/h1]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix bug relating to storage and retrieval of weapons and armor if done in a certain way, and prevent storage of more than one of the same equipment at once at in the Confirm UI.
[*] Fix a couple of typos on some Kanban in the mid-game.
[*] Fix ぬ not being an ontological strike on the ヌー enemy. There has always been support for Hiragana and Katakana to both work on all enemies that have non-kanji names.
[*] Fix a soft-crash that can occur with under 3% chance when receiving a gifted item from an akuma after a successful negotiation.
[*] Fix other reported typos found in some Youkyuu
[*] Fix screen tearing on the PS5
[/list]

[h3]Polish / Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added even better special effects for a big boss battle in Labyrinth 7.
[/list]

[h3]Our Biggest Feature / Fix Priorities[/h3]
[list]
[*] PS5 Save Data Transfer from Demo to Full Game (optional for those who want to use it).
[*] A fix for Inventory and Storage to make it a little bit more forgiving / reasonable and allow for more items to be held at once (specifically: Resources and Materials).
[*] Allowing L3 / 1's "English Mode" to be usable on any and all menus in the game.
[*] Remapping a few instances of R3 / CTRL to other keybinds, and implementing QOL such that R3 / CTRL can be used to forcibly change every text to a certain display type (English, Japanese, Furigana, Romaji) to be usable on any and all menus in the game.
[*] New option to select the set of glyphs to use for PC and Steam Deck users (Microsoft set, PlayStation set, etc).
[*] New option to default to Keyboard glyphs EVEN if a controller is connected (rare case, but a desire for this was voiced by a gamer).
[*] Fix display issues and allow the game to run properly on all ultrawide monitors.
[*] Fix potential issue with soft-locking movement in Labyrinth 5 (have yet to reproduce this).
[*] Adjust Kanban that teach Grammar / Words so that the sentences on the top take the whole width, as this will reduce instances of "small font" present in some signboards.
[*] Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night (sometimes Dawn), but also sometimes on the Nation Map.
[*] D-pad movement, especially with controller, as well as keyboard-only movement, can be slow and laggy, and not fun for dungeon-crawlers who are more accustomed to D-pad movement (instead of the L-stick, which currently is the smoothest working solution).
[*] Under certain circumstances, the Curse ailment does not always trigger in battle.
[*] Crash reports due to running out of memory on the PS4 (base console, not the PS4 Pro).
[/list]

Thank you for playing Shujinkou. The team and I are excited to see more and more players progress through the game. Some of our players have finally cleared the first major story arc, and the feedback has been amazing and extremely reassuring. The team and I are excited to see what our players think of the second major story arc!

Thanks again, and happy dungeon-crawling!
Julian Rice

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.28
notes.content:
[h1]Shujinkou v1.28[/h1]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added one missing support dialogue in the youkyuu: Nightmare in Noyama. If you were trying to talk to Toushirou in Town 4 and it wasn't working, the TO DO (instructions) in the menu actually indicated the need to talk to 野口 (のぐち). Now if you talk to Toushirou after hunting the enemies, a support dialogue will properly play. Sorry for the inconvenience!
[*] Remove a certain shop's display from Arrival SP of Town 9
[*] Fix minor visual discrepancies in Labyrinth 8's Area 3.
[*] Fix minor visual discrepancies in Labyrinth 8's Battle Room.
[*] Fix minor visual discrepancies in Labyrinth 9's Area 1.
[*] Battle Items that are used to attack specific enemies can be bugged when using a Keyboard-only setup.
[*] Fix an enemy in Labyrinth 8 not being animated in the labyrinth.
[*] Fix certain "large-sized" dialogue in Labyrinth 8 clipping into the bottom of the dialogue box.
[*] Fix typo with defensive boost of elemental or ontological attack in the Equipment Card UI saying "Decrease own <Elemental Attack>" — it now says "Buff own <Elemental Attack>"
[*] Make a few main story progression instructions for the "To Do" in the Party Menu a bit clearer in Chapter 2.
[*] English name for the Magic Focus Arawasu skill and Cure Confused Arawasu skill were overlapping, so the former remains as "To Focus" and the latter is now named "To Reorient"
[*] Fix error exception / pink-crash screen that rarely appears on the developer's end if the player quits the game while quickly moving around a town with many light systems.
[*] Fix rare pink-crash screen that can appear when quickly cycling and mashing through the Arawasu and Main Battle screens.
[*] Fix a dialogue choice bug in the youkyuu: Swimming Lessons.
[*] Added one missing instance of dialogue with the Shimauma in Town 6 right after arriving at Town 6.
[*] Fixed a dialogue issue with Sugi's Kizuna (Quest 2). Specifically after defeating the boss, there should be dialogue that appears, but it did not trigger for one Steam player. [i]*If you are the player affected by this and want to see the 20-line or so dialogue that took place after the battle, please ping @Julian on the official Shujinkou Discord server here—he will provide you with a video clip of the scene playing out: [url=https://discord.gg/UdCdvSuwpk]Discord Server URL[/url][/i]
[/list]
[h3]Polish / Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make the "Ladder" to the other side of the town a bit more obvious in Town 5.
[*] Slightly move Asada to the left in Town 5.
[*] Ensure a certain character in Chapter 2 doesn't appear on the loading screen by pushing when they appear back by a bit.
[*] Fix a few inconsistent sizing for some entities in Town 9.
[*] Added better error logging and detection regarding items that are used in the Partner Kizuna quests.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] MR Cost for "To Heal Mana": 15 MR → 25 MR
[*] TR Cost for "To Heal Health": 5 TR → 30 TR
[*] TR and MR Cost for "To Gradually Heal": 30 → 40
[*] Reduced SPD and MAG, Increased FOR, EXP, and Gin for: Sakana (さかな)
[*] Reduce a bit of narrative yapping in Labyrinth 9 to improve game flow and allow for more focused dungeon crawling.
[/list]
We are aware that the game is not perfect, and we have received many requests for various quality-of-life fixes and more. Rice Games has dedicated tremendous time and effort over the last six years to turn Shujinkou from a concept to a video game that has launched globally on multiple platforms, and will continue to remain dedicated and steadfast in providing the best customer support, QOL-implementations, and quick responses to queries from gamers who have purchased Shujinkou or have played through the Shujinkou Demo.

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
We are aware of the following issues and are looking into solutions:
[list]
[*] Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night (sometimes Dawn), but also sometimes on the Nation Map.
[*] D-pad lag in various environments when keyboard and controller are both connected.
[*] Small maru (like in ぴ) may not appear on all instances seen in dialogue
[*] Under certain circumstances, the Curse ailment does not always trigger in battle.
[*] If you have fewer than 15 MB of free space left on your computer and you have Data Analytics enabled, a harmless pink crash may occur during battle once in a while. The solution to this is to free up some space on your computer, or disable Data Analytics via the Party Menu.
[*] The game does not display properly on some [b]ultrawide monitors[/b]
[*] There may be a resolution issue when loading the game on Mac versions (unconfirmed).
[/list]
[h3]Requested Quality-of-Life Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New option to select glyph set if on Steam Deck. Currently, it always defaults to the Microsoft / Xbox glyph set.
[*] New option to default to Keyboard glyph set even if a controller or joystick is connected, specific to PC users.
[*] Find ways to make Town Navigation a bit smoother.
[*] Allow 4-way font-display cycling of text for various UI, similar to how the implementation is done for the Item Compendium menu.
[/list]
[h3]Regarding Developer Contact[/h3]
As stated in the rules of the official Shujinkou Discord Server, fellow gamers should not be sending private messages to members of the team, including the director. Contact regarding key requests, streaming opportunities, business discussion, and more should be sent to contact@ricegames.net. This has been a server rule for over 4 years now, yet some people on the team are receiving a lot of private message requests. Please keep this in mind if you are curious as to why your messages are not receiving responses—also, please note that this is an extremely busy period and that bug reports and polish will continue to take precedent over the next few weeks.

[h3]Thank You![/h3]
Thank you for playing Shujinkou. The team and I are excited to see more and more players progress through the game. [b]Already, over a thousand gamers around the world are crawling through Shujinkou's dungeons[/b], playing through the Genya Arc on PS5, PS4, PC, and Mac, with some of the most dedicated players already spending over 100 hours fighting the Akuma, learning language, and enjoying bonding events with the Fuu Lobby partners while still working their way towards clearing the first story arc. The team and I are truly honored.

Warm regards, and happy dungeon-crawling!
Julian Rice

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v1.05)
notes.content:
Heya! We've got a new patch released for the demo. A couple more important bugs have been addressed and squashed, and a few QOL additions have made their way into the Demo.

[h1]Patch Notes 1.05 (November 25th, 2024)[/h1]
[h2]QOL / Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Feature[/b]: Sprint by Default - False by default, but you can now go to the Options Menu to change movement so that players can SPRINT by default rather than walk.
[*] Select "End tutorial button" on Back press - If you are using a controller and end up deselecting the button for ending a tutorial, you can now press "Back" (Circle button, B on Xbox) to go back.
[*] Controller's R Stick now moves more smoothly when selecting kanakae orbs in battle. It used to default to a set position on the screen, but now the cursor can move in a circular direction. Some added buffers also prevent the cursor from auto-selecting an orb without the player's intention.
[*] Size of the Uma enemy (Horse) has been increased.
[*] Minor balancing for some bosses in Genya and enemies in Sanrin.
[*] Adjust Tsuri (Fishing) algorithm so that the grade of the Bait that you select has a greater impact on how easy (or difficult) it is to fish up any kind of fish.
[*] Remove the unnecessary and slightly too-wordy "Storage" tutorial.
[*] Polish all textual data for example words used in all Hiragana and Katakana Kanban so that the font doesn't become too small and so that it's legible even on smaller screens (like the Steam Deck).
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Forge sometimes doesn't work when first pressing the "Forge" button. Fixed!
[*] Fix Battle Speed setting sometimes lasting beyond the end of battle.
[*] Prevent menu scroll null exception error that would rarely take place if a player spammed inputs when leaving the game and returning to the main menu.
[*] Fix issue with Tsuri (Fishing) minigame's input not working properly on certain devices if a controller is connected and the D-pad is used as an input, and when Hold to Mash is turned off.
[*] Fix issue with Jin's Nen'oshi being rounded up to a whole number only for display, when the value should be rounded down.
[*] Fix a formula issue with Ontological Weaknesses not increasing the damage multiplier as much as it really should (now you'll deal [i]EVEN MORE[/i] damage!)
[/list]

Thank you for taking the time to read our patch notes!
Julian

notes.content:
Hello! We've got a new patch released for the demo. Because we didn't post an announcement for the initial two patches, which took place on Day 1 and 2 respectively when the demo was released, the notes for those patches will be included here too.

[h1]Patch Notes 1.03 (November 13th, 2024)[/h1]

[b]Add "Reminder to Save" toggle option in Options Menu.[/b]
[list]
[*] If enabled, the game will remind you after a few consecutive random encounters (if you have not saved) to save. If you say yes, the game will save immediately—this streamlines gameplay and grinding a bit and reduces the need to have to always go to the Party Menu to save.
[*] If disabled, the game will not remind you to save.
[*] When this appears in-game, you have the option to Snooze. Snoozing will automatically turn the toggle option OFF/disabled. You can adjust these settings again in the Options menu.
[*] IMPORTANT: This setting is set to OFF/disabled if you already have existing save data.
[/list]
[b]Add "Visible in Background" toggle option in Options Menu.[/b]
[list]
[*] If enabled, the game remains active when changing tabs/screens/monitors/apps.
[*] If disabled, the game's app/music stops and/or disappears when changing tabs/screens/monitors/apps.
[/list]
[b]Implement up/down paging for the Kemono Kiroku (Bestiary)[/b]
[list]
[*] Usually you can skip through (10 entries at a time) by pressing Left/Right, but now you can also press Down when on the last active button, and press Up when on the first active button, and that will automatically take you to the next page of enemies/akuma to view.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Pause main menu music during the Dedication screen and wait until the player clicks to continue before resuming the music
[*] Fix exception when spamming inputs right after leaving the game to return to the main menu.
[*] Fix exception when saving and loading the game after using an Arawasu skill that acts similarly to a Field item.
[*] Fix exception when quickly mashing inputs in Mokubukiya and other shops to buy or sell items.
[*] Fix input soft-lock when quickly mashing enter/exit inputs in Omikuji
[*] Improve wooden ladle position in the first special Sadou illustration with Momoko.
[/list]
[h1]Patch Notes 1.02 (November 4th, 2024)[/h1]
